newsitem.title: GEORGIA: SOCCER-GEORGIA, MOLDOVA WORLD CUP SQUADS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GEORGIA, MOLDOVA WORLD CUP SQUADS.

text.p: Georgia and Moldova squads for their European zone group two World Cup qualifier in Batumi, Georgia on Saturday:
Goalkeepers - Irakli Zoidze, (Dynamo Tbilisi), Nika Togonidze (Dynamo Batumi).

Defenders - Kakha Tskhadadze, Levan Kobiashvili (both Alania Vladikavkaz, Russia), Nugzar Lobdzhanidze (CSKA Moscow, Russia), Georgy Chikhradze (Shakhtar Donetsk, Ukraine), Kakha Kaladze (Dynamo Tbilisi), Gela Shekiladze (Dynamo Batumi).

Midfielders - Kakha Gogichaishvili, Georgy Kiknadze, Georgy Anchabadze, (all Dynamo Tbilisi), Georgy Nemsadze, Gocha Dzhamarauli (both Trabzonspor, Turkey), Gocha Gakhokidze (Alania Vladikavkaz), Temur Ketsbaia (Newcastle United, England), Georgy Kinkladze (Manchester City, England), Temur Tugushi (Dynamo Batumi).
Forwards - Mikhail Kavelashvili (Manchester City), Archil Arveladze (Trabzonspor), Zaza Dzhanashia (Lokomotiv Moscow, Russia).
Goalkeepers - Denis Romanenko (Zimbru Chisinau), Yevgeny Ivanov (Tiligul Tiraspol), Sergei Dinov (Constructorul Chisinau).
Defenders - Serghei Secu (Tiligul Tiraspol), Yuri Platon (Constructorul Chisinau), Vasile Tolokonnikov, Ion Testemitanu, Vitaly Culibaba, Oleg Fistican (all Zimbru Chisinau).

Midfielders - Radu Rebeja, Marin Spinu, Serghei Epureanu (all Zimbru Chisinau), Oleg Shishkin (Constructorul Chisinau), Alexander Popovici, Sergei Belous (both Tiligul Tiraspol), Alexander Curtianu (Widzew Lodz, Poland).
Forwards - Yuri Miterev, Alexander Sukharev (both Zimbru Chisinau), Serghei Rogachev (Olimpia Balti), Serghei Kleshchenko (Go Ahead Eagles, Netherlands).
